stem.text: Monochromatic light of wavelength $\lambda$ is incident on two narrow slits $\text{S}_\text{1}$ and $\text{S}_\text{2}$, a small distance apart. A series of bright and dark fringes are observed on a screen a long distance away from the slits.

stem.alt: Two narrow slits labelled S1 (upper) and S2 (lower), with parallel incoming arrows labelled light wavelength λ from the left; straight lines from each slit meet at P on a vertical screen.

stem.text: The $n$th **dark** fringe from the central bright fringe is observed at point P on the screen.
Which equation is correct for all positive values of $n$?
